item.title: AIMS-z: astrophysics-informed machine learning for spectroscopic redshifts of quasars
item.description: AIMS-z is an astrophysics-informed machine-learning project for reliable quasar redshifts, reusable spectral representations, and multimodal inference, with an initial focus on Euclid slitless spectra.
